name: Overlays
summary: How to build a modal, drawer, or popover — surface choice, safety-critical dismiss behaviour, state reset, drawer placement/width, the async-confirm pattern, inline error surfacing, and danger-styled confirms — built from existing components.
highlights: How to build a modal, drawer or popover
Surface choice, safety-critical dismiss, state reset, drawer placement and width
Async confirm, inline errors, danger-styled confirms
lead: Overlays are where a stray backdrop click can destroy data, so they need shared safety rules or every confirm/delete/detail surface drifts. This pattern ships NO new component: it documents how to compose an AntD Modal/Drawer/Popover with the shared Button, the AhaAlert banner, and useIsMobile() so dismiss behaviour, state reset, and error handling stay consistent and safe. The narrative 'why', worked examples, and full assertion set live in the DS `overlays` guide; this artifact carries only what the repo can enforce, traced back by ref.

skillRef.note: This guide is the source of truth for rationale, the DeleteSurveyConfirmModal/RespondentReportDrawer references, and the full OVERLAY-01..09 assertions. This pattern distils the enforceable subset and links each rule back by ref; the judge closes the build→judge→fix loop.

surfaceChoice.useFor: a focused decision or short flow that should block the page
a detail view or medium-complexity panel that supplements the page without replacing it
a small, anchored, contextual snippet — not multi-step flows
surfaceChoice.example: quick info, a compact input, an upsell

composedOf.use: the bottom sheet a list click launches — <aha-drawer placement="bottom"> in React, Vue 2 and Vue 3; its Esc and Tab leave popups open inside it
the confirm/cancel CTAs; destructive confirm is a default Button (okButtonProps type default + loading, no danger prop), Cancel the primary

footer action glyphs — functional icons only, via the shared Icon; the Modal and Drawer dismiss ✕ is the shared ✕ (tertiary icon-only <aha-button>, size xs; 20 × 20, 16px system-x, #8A8A8A → #1A1A1A on #F7F7F7, top-pinned to the title line) through dismissibleModalTitle / dismissibleDrawerTitle with closable={false}
danger confirm colour — never hardcode a hex
the blocking-decision surface (confirmations, destructive actions) — AntD v6 Modal with mask/keyboard/destroyOnHidden props wired per these rules
the detail/panel surface — AntD v6 Drawer with placement=right, responsive width, footer actions, destroyOnClose; the list-launched bottom sheet is <aha-drawer placement="bottom">
the anchored contextual snippet surface — AntD v6 Popover
the inline in-overlay error banner (AhaAlert / DS V3 Alert, owned by the `feedback` guide) — never a bare AntD Alert
the hover/focus hint inside an overlay (a drawer's ? help glyph): <aha-tooltip> repositions inside its clipping panel and the viewport, so it is never cut off at the drawer edge
a menu opened inside an overlay: <aha-dropdown> opens its flyout on the side with room, so it is not cut off at the panel edge

componentBacklog: composedOf marks 4 components this pattern needs that the DS does not yet ship (modal, drawer, popover, alert). Per the charter, a pattern that leans on a missing component is a signal to add it HERE — this is the pattern surfacing the component roadmap (the Alert overlaps the `feedback` guide's banner).

rules.rule: Pick the surface by the job: Modal for a blocking decision or short flow, Drawer for a detail/medium-complexity panel that supplements the page, Popover for a small anchored snippet — never a multi-step flow in a popover.

Open an overlay (modal, drawer, popover, toast, coachmark) only as the direct result of an explicit user action on that screen, never on load, a timer, scroll, sign-in or a first visit (a timer the user set, such as a slide timer closing submissions with Time's up, is their action); the only exceptions are information whose absence would cause the user obvious damage (unsaved work, an expiring session, a failed payment) and a promotional popup for a free-plan user who signed up over 14 days ago.

Destructive overlays MUST NOT dismiss on outside/mask click — set mask={{ closable: false }} on the Modal, leaving Esc (keyboard) and the X button as the only dismiss paths. Non-destructive overlays may allow mask-close.
While an async action is in flight (busy), disable cancel and suppress onCancel/onClose so the user cannot dismiss mid-operation.

Always set destroyOnHidden (Modal) / destroyOnClose (Drawer) so transient state — form input, error text, busy flag — resets between opens. If the instance can stay mounted, also clear local error and busy on open; don't rely on unmount alone.

Side drawers default to placement="right" with responsive width width={isMobile ? '100%' : 720} via useIsMobile(). A launch surface opened from a list of objects (one click on a deck) is a bottom sheet: <aha-drawer placement="bottom"> in every framework, full width, 48px top gap that closes on click, 16px top corners, grab handle, Esc, ✕ and swipe down close it, full page under 768px. Never hand-build a sheet from a fixed div.
Put navigation/actions (prev/next, retry, position indicator) in the drawer footer, and use styles={{ body: { padding: 0 } }} when the body renders its own padded content.
For confirmations, the modal title is a question ("Delete this survey permanently?").

A destructive confirm uses okButtonProps={{ type: 'default', loading: busy }} — a plain default button (white, 1px #E3E3E3 border, #1A1A1A label, the look of aha-button secondary), never the danger prop and never a solid dark fill, and nothing on the title or body — and Cancel, the safe choice, is the primary button (cancelButtonProps={{ type: 'primary', disabled: busy }}), disabled while busy. A Popconfirm gets both from destructiveConfirm in popconfirm-theme.

onConfirm returns a promise: guard re-entry (if (busy) return), set busy, clear prior error, then await the action. On rejection stay open, surface the error inline, and clear busy; on success the caller closes. Never close a destructive overlay before its action resolves, and never fire-and-forget.

Surface failures inside the overlay with an inline DS V3 Alert (AhaAlert, styling owned by the `feedback` guide, type owned by `ux-writing` UXW-5: a retryable error is type="warning", a failure trying again can't fix is type="error") — never a bare AntD Alert, never a nested modal stacked on top, never a downgrade to a transient toast. The overlay stays open on failure so the user can retry without re-opening.

An overlay is never clipped by its panel or the viewport: a tooltip, popover or menu inside a drawer, modal or scroll area shows its whole bubble even when its trigger sits at the edge. Use <aha-tooltip>, which moves to the side with room inside its clipping panel and slides along it (placement stays the preference), <aha-popover flip> or <aha-dropdown>, which open on the roomier side, and <aha-select>, whose list sits in the top layer so an overflow:hidden card cannot cut it off; never hand-position a bubble on a fixed side. Gated: screen-lint.mjs --measure hard-fails overlay-clip on a consumer screen, and qa.mjs runs the same check on every built DS page.

A focus ring is never clipped by an overflow container: a control at the edge of a modal body, drawer, popover list or any overflow: auto / hidden / scroll box shows its whole ring. The DS rings reach out 4px at most: a keyboard ring is a 2px outline at a 2px offset (--aha-border-focus, 4px out), a field ring (<aha-input>, select, textarea) is a 2px box-shadow (--aha-focus-ring-soft, 2px out). Fix it on the container, never on the control: give the scroll container padding of at least 4px (--aha-space-4) and pull it back with an equal negative margin (margin: calc(-1 * var(--aha-space-4))) so the content stays where it was; <aha-modal> does this for its own body. Never remove, shrink or restyle the ring to dodge the clip: the DS ships no inset ring, and an inset ring on a DS control is a restyle. Gated: screen-lint.mjs --measure hard-fails focus-ring-clip on a consumer screen (it focuses every reachable control and measures the ring against its overflow containers).

A tooltip is the default size (12px name, wraps at 280px) on every product, settings, audience and website screen, the editor header and toolbars included. size="lg" (16px name on a 24px line) is the canvas tooltip: only for a control inside the slide canvas and the presenting view's control bar (app-shell C6). An lg tooltip beside 12px ones in the editor reads as a different component. Gated: screen-lint.mjs hard-fails tooltip-size on any tooltip tag (<aha-tooltip>, a wrapper whose name contains tooltip) with a literal size="lg" on every surface but canvas; a presenter control-bar line opts out with ds-lint-allow: tooltip-size (presenter control bar).

reuseNote: Doc-only pattern — ships no composition wrapper from this repo. The canonical overlay references live in the product (DeleteSurveyConfirmModal.tsx for the destructive modal, RespondentReportDrawer.tsx for the detail drawer); the AhaAlert banner is owned by the `feedback` guide and useIsMobile() by the `shared-components` guide. If a shared overlay wrapper graduates into this DS, add a reuse block and it is gated like a composite.

selfCheck.label: surface fits the job (modal blocking / drawer panel / popover snippet)
destructive overlays set mask closable:false; Esc + X only; no dismiss while busy
destroyOnHidden/destroyOnClose set; side drawer placement=right + responsive width; list-launched surface is aha-drawer placement=bottom
async confirm awaits, stays open on failure with an inline AhaAlert; danger on the button
no focus ring clipped: scroll containers pad 4px (--aha-space-4) with an equal negative margin; aha-modal body does it built in
